stage.manual: The host gives the signal to continue.
stage.timeUp: Time is up. Take your time to finish.
stage.private: The show is here. Your choices stay on your controller.
stage.rulesContinue: The game continues while these rules are open. The host can pause it.
lobby.title: The party is waiting for its stars.
lobby.scan: Scan. Join. Go off the rails.
lobby.help: Open the link on your phone and choose your nickname.
program.title: Tonight’s line-up of trouble.
program.help: Your phone is your controller. The stage takes care of the show.
action.write: Write your answer on your controller.
action.prepare: Prepare your performance, then mark yourself ready.
action.vote: Make your choice on your controller.
action.product: As seen on TV · absolutely unbelievable
action.inventors: THE INVENTORS ARE HARD AT WORK!
action.inventorHelp: The engineers are working. No qualifications have been checked.
action.rate: Rate this presentation on your controller.
court.accusationHelp: Prosecutor, present the facts. However ridiculous they may be.
court.defenseHelp: Lawyer, save your client’s reputation. If possible.
court.questionsHelp: The judge gives the floor to witnesses and jurors.
court.finalHelp: Prosecution, defence, defendant: one last chance to convince the jury.
reveal.empty: No answers to reveal this time. The show goes on.
reveal.anonymous: Authors remain secret until the results.
results.title: Admit it. It was you.
results.hidden: Points stay backstage until the leaderboard selected by the host.
results.defence: The defence and defendant win the case. A tie favours the defence.
results.pitchNext: Points are awarded after the final seller.
cinema.writers: THE SCRIPT IS GOING OFF THE RAILS.
cinema.private: Images and dialogue stay on the phones until the premiere.
cinema.readyHelp: Performers discover their film on their controller. Their notes stay private.
cinema.voteHelp: Award three prizes on your controllers: best film, best actor and best line.
leaderboard.title: The leaderboard is moving.
transition.title: Shall we catch our breath?
quip.welcome: Welcome to the only show where losing the plot is part of the rules.
quip.podium: A huge round of applause! You have officially sent tonight off the rails.
quip.rules: The rules are simple. Your interpretation probably won’t be.
quip.intro: Next stop: {game}. Keep your controllers handy.
quip.oral: The microphone is open. The host controls the next speaking turn.
quip.writing.0: Good ideas are coming. Thankfully, so are the bad ones.
quip.writing.1: Quality control has left the building. Make the most of it.
quip.writing.2: A brilliant answer? We accept the other kind too.
quip.voting.0: Democracy has rarely had so much to answer for.
quip.voting.1: One small vote for you. One giant doubt for humankind.
quip.voting.2: Vote with your heart. Common sense is taking a break.
quip.reveal.1: The standard is rising. Or the floor is sinking.
quip.reveal.2: This is exactly when everything goes off the rails.
quip.results.0: The numbers have spoken. They have asked to remain anonymous.
quip.results.1: The points are official. The excuses are still free.
quip.results.2: Applause is allowed. So is a total lack of self-awareness.
quip.last: Ten seconds. Trust your first bad idea.
rules.noPoints: Tonight is just for fun: no points are awarded.
rules.balance: Scoring follows the balancing and multipliers selected by the host.

mythos.title: The truth? Optional.
mythos.text: Invent the funniest explanation for a seriously questionable question.

mythos.title: Everyone has an invention
mythos.text: Write on your controller. Your answer stays private until the reveal.

mythos.title: The clock is ticking
mythos.text: You have {answer} seconds. Once everyone has answered, the party host reveals each answer.

mythos.title: Make way for the liars
mythos.text: Answers appear one at a time, without their authors.

mythos.title: The audience decides
mythos.text: Vote for your favourite answer in {vote} seconds. You cannot vote for yourself.

mythos.title: Outstanding nonsense
mythos.text: 100 points per vote received and 150 for the leading answers.

pitch.title: High-voltage shopping TV
pitch.text: Convince the audience that an unsellable product will change their lives.

pitch.title: Your next masterpiece
pitch.text: Invent a product or ask House Decoy for an idea. Edit it before submitting.

pitch.title: A surprise delivery
pitch.text: Inventions are shuffled. Everyone gets someone else’s product and prepares a pitch.

pitch.title: The microphone is yours
pitch.text: One seller at a time. The timer is a guide: the host ends each presentation.

pitch.title: Three ratings, no mercy
pitch.text: After each pitch, everyone else rates humour, conviction and creativity from 1 to 5.

pitch.title: Who made a fortune?
pitch.text: Average rating × 100. A 100-point creator bonus if the product reaches 4/5. Points are awarded at the end.

court.title: Order in the chaos
court.text: An absurd crime, a questionable defence and a verdict decided by the jury.

court.title: Everyone has a role
court.text: Defendant, prosecutor, lawyer, judge, jurors and witnesses: check your private role.

court.title: Prepare your performance
court.text: You have {answer} seconds. Your notes stay private, even after the trial.

court.title: Respect the floor
court.text: The stage shows who is speaking. The host gives the next signal. The timer cuts nobody off.

court.title: The verdict is secret
court.text: Only jurors vote guilty or not guilty. Everyone else chooses the best performance.

court.title: Justice pays
court.text: 300 points to the prosecutor if guilty, otherwise to the lawyer and defendant. 150 for best performance.

who.title: You know each other so well…
who.text: Choose the person who best fits the question.

who.title: Exchange knowing looks
who.text: The question is public. Your vote stays on your controller.

who.title: Time to get suspicious
who.text: You have {vote} seconds. Voting closes as soon as everyone chooses.

who.title: Own your choice
who.text: The host’s settings decide whether you can vote for yourself.

who.title: The big revelation
who.text: Discover the vote distribution and the most nominated people.

who.title: Collective instinct
who.text: +100 points for picking a leading choice, including ties. No automatic points for the person selected.

captions.title: Welcome to the cinema
captions.text: Real film scenes. Dialogue rewritten together. A result nobody can predict.

captions.title: Your opening line
captions.text: Look at your private frame and write the start of the story. The TV reveals nothing.

captions.title: Pass the script
captions.text: On the next turn, continue another story using the lines already written.

captions.title: Live dubbing
captions.text: Each player receives a complete film. Read its dialogue and perform it out loud.

captions.title: You control the pace
captions.text: The performer or host advances the frames. The host ends the presentation when you are done.

captions.title: Three movie awards
captions.text: Vote for best film, best actor and best line. Authors are revealed in the credits.
